{{Top|leg}}
'''Synthetic diamonds''' were created by exiled [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] from their dead using industrial-grade [[Artificial gravity generator/Legends|gravity generators]]. The body would first be cremated then the carbon residue is compressed into diamonds. The diamonds were then brought to the [[Corellian Sanctuary|Sanctuary]] and embedded into the black walls and ceiling to create a glittering series of constellations, as seen from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
